name: Crate of Crash Helmets
summary: At the Shimmering Flats, Wizzle Brassbolts and his brother need helmets for their rocket car test drivers. Heavy dwarven Siege Engine headgear is bound for Thousand Needles to guard pilots against concussions.

sections.title: Safety at High Speeds
sections.body: Gnome engineers race rocket cars across the Shimmering Flats. Wizzle Brassbolts and his brother build machines that outrun their drivers’ ability to steer. Crashes leave test pilots with head injuries, and leather caps no longer suffice. So heavy dwarven Siege Engine helmets are shipped across the sea to keep the drivers conscious and alive.

faq.q: What is inside the Crate of Crash Helmets?
faq.answer: The crate holds heavy Siege Engine helmets taken from dwarven military stocks. Their thick protection guards against concussive blasts and hard impacts during high-speed trials.
Wizzle Brassbolts and his brother need the helmets at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats. Their designs leave test pilots with head injuries, so the drivers need serious protection.

faq.q: Why are the Brassbolts brothers crashing so much?
faq.answer: The Brassbolts brothers build for speed and push the limits of gnomish engineering, with little regard for stable handling. Their rocket car moves so fast that collisions on the salt flats are almost unavoidable.

faq.q: Where are the helmets being delivered?
faq.answer: The helmets are bound for the Shimmering Flats, a vast salt plain in southeastern Thousand Needles, Kalimdor.

angles.text: Engineers know the balance between propulsion and failure. They know how much heavy armor matters when safety features come second.
As a gnome at the Mirage Raceway, you see pilot concussions come with the work of out-innovating goblin rivals on the salt flats.
